source.name: Household net worth statistics: Year ended June 2024
source.assumptions: Q1-Q4 and the bulk of Q5 are real Stats NZ quintile aggregates (~411,740 households/quintile, ~2.06M households total; band edges between quintiles are interpolated between published medians, not exact Stats NZ cut points). Stats NZ doesn't publish bands above ~$1.5M net worth, which can't resolve a $10M+ wealth-tax threshold (see TODO.md) - so the top quintile has been split into an ordinary 'rest of Q5' band and a separate ultra-wealthy band, with the ultra-wealthy band's count/average back-calculated to match the Green Party's own 2026 costing (~$3.8bn/year at 2.5% above $10M) rather than sourced independently. Values are in $K to match the income dataset's convention.
